verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS invoicing product that stores customer and payment data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on retention periods, account or data deletion, or purge controls. The security claims (PCI-DSS, SSL, 2FA) and the general API parity statement are adjacent and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
